title: Dune
desc: In the distant future, noble House Atreides is assigned control of the desert planet Arrakis — sole source of the universe's most valuable resource, spice — only to walk into a deadly trap set by rival House Harkonnen and the Emperor. Directed by Denis Villeneuve and starring Timothée Chalamet, Rebecca Ferguson, Oscar Isaac, Zendaya, and Jason Momoa.
tidbits: Denis Villeneuve insisted the novel be split into two films from day one; Legendary only greenlit Part One first and waited to see if it worked before approving the sequel.
Hans Zimmer turned down the Tenet score to take Dune instead — a lifelong dream project — and built the soundtrack partly around custom instruments and unconventional human voices.
Stellan Skarsgård spent hours daily under heavy Baron Harkonnen prosthetics and makeup; the look was designed to feel grotesque and oppressive rather than cartoonish.
Much of the Arrakis desert was shot in Jordan's Wadi Rum and Abu Dhabi; the production also filmed in Budapest and Norway for Caladan and other worlds.
The film won six Oscars (including Cinematography, Score, and Visual Effects) after a simultaneous theatrical + HBO Max release that Villeneuve publicly criticized.
